mechanism: Clarithromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and has potential additive negative inotropic and chronotropic effects with beta-blockers; atenolol is renally eliminated and not significantly hepatically metabolized, limiting major CYP interaction.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure; assess for bradycardia, hypotension, or worsening cardiac function; consider alternative antibiotic if significant cardiac effects emerge.
